release.hideLoadedStone: Hide Trebuchet_LoadedStone at clip fraction 0.15 until fraction 0.85. Clone its ordinary child mesh/group and preserve world scale for a detached projectile.

integration.doNotNormalizeAgainstIdleBounds: The complete sling sweep extends beyond the ready pose. The authored scale already reserves the entire animation inside the existing 4.8 m collision radius.

modifications: Converted original COLLADA geometry, 34-bone skeletal rig, and Idle/Attack animations to a self-contained GLB using Three.js 0.170.0.

Combined the original trebuchet, original counterweight-stone prop and original onager projectile according to the creator actor attachments; omitted external crew and loose ammunition props because the game supplies its own crew.
Decoded original DDS textures to RGB PNG, embedded both albedos, and assigned nonmetallic rough MeshStandardMaterials. No image upscaling was applied.
Triangulated the projectile source polygon declarations for the COLLADA importer; preserved all original projectile faces.
Preserved Blender Z-up skeletal axes beneath a Y-up scene wrapper; mapped original animation tracks by bone name and removed redundant consecutive animation samples.
Applied one uniform scale and translation using the complete 240 Hz sampled attack envelope, grounding the feet at Y=0 and keeping all animated geometry inside a 4.65 m horizontal radius.
Named separate counterweight and loaded-stone groups and added integration metadata. The loaded stone can be cloned independently for flight.
This model adaptation is distributed under CC-BY-SA-3.0.
